_note: English translation of team.json. Names kept as Anastazja and Ina, as on the Polish site and the booking platforms. Translated by Claude, reviewed by a native speaker (2026-11-13).

bio: Anastazja is a qualified massage therapist with more than 5 years of experience and a real passion for bodywork. She completed two years of training as a massage technician, gaining a solid medical and anatomical foundation.
In her daily practice, Anastazja focuses on an individual approach. She smoothly blends different massage techniques into a signature treatment tailored to each person’s needs.
Ina is an experienced massage therapist, a long-time yoga teacher, an aromatherapist and a yoga therapist.
She specialises in working with people who experience stress, deep muscle tension, back and neck pain, overload and psychosomatic fatigue.
